patch_description: This implementation replaces the alpha-beta state tracker with a causal robust multi-scale local-regression filter. At each sample it fits both short-horizon and long-horizon exponentially weighted local linear models over the trailing window. Huber reweighting suppresses impulses, while model residual scales determine whether the responsive short model is trustworthy enough to influence the output. The fitted endpoint estimates provide substantially less phase delay than a trailing average, and a slope-consensus reversal gate suppresses noise-driven directional changes without preventing sustained real turns. The approach uses sliding robust regression rather than recursive state estimation, making it fundamentally different from the prior tracker.
